description:
The 2017 Toyota Corolla welcomes you with a serene, uncluttered cabin experience, immediately emphasizing calm through soft-touch materials and a quiet ride.

Buyers seeking classic refinement and high-value features in a sedan will find the Corolla's interior ambiance tailored for daily comfort and enduring appeal. The fabric seat trim and telescoping steering wheel enable a customized, ergonomic drive, while the illuminated entry and steering wheel-mounted audio controls provide a tactile sense of quality. Those who appreciate technology’s role in convenience will note the hands-on ease of speed control, power windows, and a trip computer that keeps essential information close at hand. This sedan is ideal for those who prioritize a composed, feature-rich environment with proven Toyota reliability.

Driving this vehicle is an exercise in subtlety and smoothness, with a focus on minimizing noise, vibration, and harshness for a relaxed commute. The front wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering work in tandem to absorb road imperfections, resulting in a cabin that remains hushed even on uneven pavement. The automatic transmission transitions cleanly between gears, complementing the sedan’s reputation for effortlessness. With a 28/36 city/highway MPG rating, the Corolla delivers not just quiet, but also efficient, seamless power ideal for both urban and highway cruising.

Safety in this sedan is engineered to blend seamlessly into daily routines, offering discreet yet effective protection. Dual front impact and side airbags, an overhead airbag, and a knee airbag are complemented by electronic stability control and traction control, creating a cocoon of security. The exterior parking camera rear enhances situational awareness without drawing attention, while fully automatic headlights and ABS brakes operate in the background to quietly manage changing conditions. These active systems contribute to a premium sense of reassurance, letting occupants focus on the journey.

A considered set of features underscores the Corolla’s approach to accessible luxury. The Entune Audio system with a 6.1-inch touchscreen offers intuitive control over entertainment and information, while AM/FM radio, CD player, and radio data system support a range of listening preferences. Air conditioning and a rear window defroster ensure year-round comfort, and the split-folding rear seat adds practicality without compromising the sedan’s streamlined design. About This 2021 Toyota Corolla LE Sedan This 2021 Toyota Corolla LE is a four-door sedan wearing 125,030 miles — a number that sounds high on the surface but tells a very different story in the context of Toyota's reputation for longevity. Corollas are routinely driven well past 200,000 miles with proper maintenance, and many owners report reaching 300,000 miles without major mechanical issues. For commuters, rideshare drivers, students, or anyone who needs a dependable daily driver without breaking the bank, this Corolla checks every box.
2021 Toyota Corolla Performance and Engine Under the hood, this Corolla LE is powered by a 1.8-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a continuously variable transmission (CVT) and front-wheel drive. Toyota's 2ZR-FAE engine in this generation delivers around 139 horsepower and is tuned for efficiency rather than excitement — and that's a good thing for most buyers. The CVT keeps the engine in its optimal power band, which translates to a smooth, composed ride whether you're navigating I-75 through Marietta or cruising on the highway toward downtown Atlanta. Expect real-world fuel economy in the upper 20s to low 30s per gallon in mixed driving, making this one of the more economical choices in the used sedan segment.
Toyota Corolla LE Features and Interior The LE trim is Toyota's entry-level Corolla grade, but it's anything but sparse. Standard features on the 2021 Corolla LE include Toyota Safety Sense 2.0 — a suite that bundles pre-collision warning with pedestrian detection, lane departure alert, automatic high beams, and radar cruise control. The cabin itself is a notable step up from previous Corolla generations — quieter, with better materials and a more modern layout that feels more premium than its price point suggests.
Toyota Corolla Reliability and Ownership The Toyota Corolla consistently ranks among the most reliable vehicles on the road, year after year. The 2021 model year earned strong scores from J.D. The 1.8-liter engine in the LE trim is a known quantity with a long service history, and the CVT, while sometimes criticized in other brands, has proven durable in Toyota applications when properly maintained. Common ownership advice includes keeping up with oil changes on schedule, checking the CVT fluid at higher mileages, and monitoring the cabin air filter. Outside of routine maintenance, most Corolla owners at this mileage report very few unexpected repair bills.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the 2021 Toyota Corolla a good used car to buy?

Yes — the 2021 Corolla LE is widely regarded as one of the best values in the used sedan market. It combines low ownership costs, strong safety ratings, and Toyota's proven reliability record. For buyers who prioritize dependability and fuel economy over performance, it's an excellent choice.

How many miles is too many for a used Toyota Corolla?

Unlike many vehicles where 100,000 miles raises red flags, a well-maintained Corolla at 125,000 miles is often just hitting its stride. Properly serviced Corollas routinely reach 200,000 to 300,000 miles. The key is reviewing the maintenance history and having the vehicle inspected before purchase.

What does the Toyota Corolla LE trim include?

The LE trim includes Toyota Safety Sense 2.0 with automatic emergency braking and lane assist, a 7-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a backup camera, Bluetooth, automatic headlights, and a comfortable, well-appointed interior. It's a strong value trim that doesn't leave out anything most buyers actually need.

Is the CVT transmission in the 2021 Corolla reliable?

Toyota's implementation of the CVT in the Corolla has been well-received for reliability, particularly when the transmission fluid is serviced at recommended intervals. Most owners report no significant issues with the transmission even at higher mileages.

What should I check before buying a used Corolla with high miles?

Focus on the service history — consistent oil changes are a strong positive indicator. Have a mechanic inspect the CVT fluid condition, check for any suspension wear, inspect the tires and brakes, and run a vehicle history report using the VIN to check for accidents or title issues.

description:
2015 BMW 320i Sedan with 122,675 miles, finished in Alpine White with a Venetian Beige Sensatec interior. This 3 Series delivers the classic BMW sport-sedan formula with rear-wheel-drive balance, turbocharged efficiency, a premium cabin layout, and the upscale features that make it a strong choice for drivers around Wesley Chapel, Tampa, Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and Brooksville who want something more refined than an ordinary compact sedan.

Power comes from a 2.0L TwinPower Turbo 4-cylinder engine paired with an 8-speed Steptronic automatic transmission. This setup gives the 320i smooth acceleration, responsive everyday performance, and excellent highway manners while still keeping fuel economy practical. With an EPA-estimated 24 MPG city and 36 MPG highway, this BMW is well suited for commuting, daily driving, and longer road trips. Rear-wheel drive gives the car the balanced, planted feel that helped define the 3 Series, while electric power-assist steering, 4-wheel disc brakes, brake assist, hill hold control, front and rear anti-roll bars, gas-pressurized shocks, strut front suspension, and multi-link rear suspension all work together to deliver a composed and confident drive.

The Alpine White exterior gives this 320i a clean, timeless look. The sedan profile is sharp and understated, with classic BMW proportions, a chrome grille, front fog lamps, body-color bumpers, body-color door handles, heated power side mirrors with turn signal indicators, light tinted glass, perimeter approach lighting, and speed-sensitive rain-detecting wipers with heated washer jets. The 17-inch alloy wheels add the right stance, while the overall appearance stays professional, refined, and easy to enjoy every day.

Inside, the Venetian Beige Sensatec cabin gives this BMW a bright and upscale feel. The Premium Package adds several important comfort and convenience features, including power front seats, lumbar support, Comfort Access keyless entry, a moonroof, auto-dimming rearview mirror, auto-dimming exterior mirrors, Universal Garage Door Opener, storage package, and SiriusXM capability. The power moonroof is a standout feature, bringing extra light into the cabin and giving the car a more open, premium feel.

Comfort features include dual-zone automatic climate control, leather-wrapped steering wheel, leather and metal-look gear shifter, sliding front center armrest, rear center armrest, front and rear cupholders, illuminated vanity mirrors, front and rear map lights, full floor console storage, additional 12V power sockets, illuminated locking glove box, cargo area lighting, and useful door and dashboard storage. The cabin has the driver-focused layout BMW is known for, with clean controls, a comfortable seating position, and a premium feel that still works well for daily use.

Technology includes hands-free Bluetooth and USB connectivity, BMW Assist eCall, BMW TeleServices, Hi-Fi sound system, 9 speakers, streaming audio, audio theft deterrent, one front LCD monitor, driver information center, outside temperature display, and steering wheel-mounted cruise controls. The system is straightforward and functional, giving you the key connectivity and audio features needed for everyday driving without overcomplicating the cabin.

Safety equipment includes front airbags, front seat-mounted side airbags, side curtain airbags for the first and second rows, driver and passenger knee airbags, rear child safety locks, tire-specific low tire pressure warning, side-impact beams, anti-lock brakes, brake assist, hill hold control, engine immobilizer, and advanced seatbelt systems. These features help give the 320i a solid safety foundation while maintaining the responsive road feel expected from a BMW sedan.
